utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli. I could use help greeting people, setting up tables, and keeping things organized on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can handle greeting people and helping with the tables on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, I can help out. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you help set up the front porch and sort donations on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll handle setup and sorting on Saturday, and I’ll bring labels and a couple of bins so things stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. That should help keep Saturday on the front porch from getting too messy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still in for Saturday on the front porch. I can help with setup, sorting, tables, and greeting people when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Vik - thank you. Could you handle the tables and greeting, and I’ll keep setup and sorting moving?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Oren — I’m lining up helpers for Saturday on the front porch and could use a hand with boxes, labels, or sorting if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can help with that. I’ll do boxes and sorting on Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — I can help this Saturday on the front porch. Just tell me what you’d like me to do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — please help set up the front porch and sort supplies when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you be there by 9 on Saturday at the front porch? I’d appreciate you helping with setup and sorting so things don’t get tangled up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can be there by 9 on Saturday at the front porch and help with setup and sorting.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
